caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure consists of two vertically stacked line plots, each depicting training rewards over steps for two different methods on Easy and Hard training sets. Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Steps," ranging from 0 to 500 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards," scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top panel and from 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom panel, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top panel (Easy Training Set), two lines are shown: a teal solid line with circular markers representing Llama-On-Policy-Easy, and a red solid line with circular markers representing Llama-LUFFY-Easy. Both lines start near 0.0 at step 0 and increase over time; by step 500, the teal line reaches approximately 0.35 and the red line reaches approximately 0.40, with both exhibiting slight fluctuations and shaded confidence intervals around them. In the bottom panel (Hard Training Set), the same two methods are plotted: the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) rises to approximately 0.05 by step 100 and then declines to near 0.0 by step 150, remaining close to 0.0 thereafter. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) starts near 0.0, gradually increases, and reaches approximately 0.20 by step 500, with visible fluctuations and shaded confidence intervals.
